# Alpha Douro — Intimate Luxury Boat Tours in Porto & the Douro River

> Alpha Douro is a boutique, human-scale boat tour operator departing from Douro Marina (Pontoon A / Pontão A, R. da Praia 430, Afurada, Vila Nova de Gaia — Porto, Portugal). Unlike crowded 90-passenger sightseeing cruises in Ribeira, Alpha Douro welcomes a maximum of 10 guests per voyage for two unhurried hours alongside the captain (Gil) and skipper, with a Douro wine tasting included on every experience and a 360° panoramic canopy for year-round comfort.

## Core Positioning
- **Maximum Capacity:** 10 guests (never crowded; intimate, personal hospitality).
- **Duration:** 2 hours on every standard voyage.
- **Included on Every Tour:** Curated Douro wine tasting on board + wool throws + year-round 360° clear panoramic canopy + free weather rescheduling.
- **Departure Point:** Douro Marina · Pontoon A (Pontão A), R. da Praia 430, 4400-554 Afurada, Vila Nova de Gaia, Porto, Portugal (GPS: 41.1409959, -8.6512348). Free parking 30 meters from the pier. Arrive 10 minutes early.
- **Direct Booking (0% Commission):** https://alphadouro.com/ | WhatsApp: +351 914 160 240 | Email: geral@alphadouro.com | Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/alphadouro/

## Experiences & Transparent Pricing
- **7 Bridges of the Douro Cruise (Daytime · 2h):** €30 per guest. Unhurried journey beneath Porto's seven historic bridges (Arrábida, Dom Luís I, Infante, Maria Pia, São João, Freixo) with Douro wine tasting included. Max. 10 guests.
- **Sunset & Sea · 7 Bridges & Foz do Douro (Golden Hour · 2h):** €60 per guest. Golden-hour cruise past the seven bridges and out towards Foz do Douro where the Douro River meets the Atlantic Ocean. Douro wine tasting included. Max. 10 guests.
- **Private Charter on the Douro (Tailor-Made · 1–10 guests):** Custom quote via WhatsApp. The entire boat reserved exclusively for couples, proposals, birthdays, or families—zero strangers on board, custom route and pace, Douro wine tasting included.
- **Personalized Gift Vouchers (Christmas, Valentine's, Birthdays):** From €30 (7 Bridges), €60 (Sunset & Sea), or Private Charter. Personalized with the recipient's name, valid 365 days, delivered instantly via WhatsApp or in a sealed luxury envelope.

- [Homepage (PT / EN / ES / DE / FR)](https://alphadouro.com/): Full experience showcase, interactive route map, transparent pricing, and direct WhatsApp booking.
- [Instagram Direct Booking Hub](https://alphadouro.com/ig/): Fast mobile booking hub for tours, private charters, gift vouchers, and Pontoon A GPS directions.
- [Digital Boarding Pass](https://alphadouro.com/pass/): Personalized mobile check-in pass with QR code, Pontoon A boarding time, calendar reminders, and wine preference selector.
